name: s1-red-science
goal: @all Automate red science (automation-science-pack) to 0.5/s (30 per minute) with assembling machines. Plates and gears must reach the science assemblers by belts and inserters: no hand-feeding of the science line. Report in chat when it runs on its own.

score.name: red_per_min_assemblers
score.note: packs finished by assemblers per game minute (hand-crafted packs excluded)

score.name: red_asm_working
score.lua: local k=0 for _,e in pairs(machines('automation-science-pack')) do if e.status==defines.entity_status.working then k=k+1 end end return k
